description: Large pothole in the middle of the road at the Kawangware stage. Matatus swerve into oncoming traffic to avoid it.
Shimo kubwa katikati ya barabara karibu na stage ya Kawangware. Matatu zinaingia upande mwingine kulikwepa.
Street lights along the road from Umoja market to the estate have been off for a week. It is very dark at night.
Taa za barabarani from Umoja market hadi estate hazijawaka for one week, ni giza sana usiku.
Blocked drain next to the primary school gate in South B floods the road every time it rains. Children walk through dirty water.
The storm drain by the school gate is full of rubbish and the road floods whenever it rains.
Burst water pipe at the junction near the chemist in Kayole. Clean water has been flowing on the road for two days.
Bomba la maji limepasuka kwenye makutano karibu na duka la dawa Kayole. Maji safi yanamwagika barabarani siku mbili sasa.
Garbage at the estate collection point in Githurai 45 has not been collected for over a week and is spilling onto the footpath.
Takataka kwa collection point ya estate Githurai 45 haijaokotwa wiki nzima, sasa inamwagika kwa footpath.
The speed bump outside the health centre in Dandora has broken up and loose stones are scattered on the road.
Broken speed bump near the dispensary, there are stones all over the road.
The high mast floodlight near the Kibera footbridge is not working. People are afraid to cross at night.
Taa kubwa ya mlingoti karibu na daraja la Kibera haiwaki. Watu wanaogopa kuvuka usiku.
The open drain along the road in Kasarani is overflowing with dirty water and the smell is very bad.
Mtaro wa Kasarani ume-overflow na maji machafu, harufu ni mbaya sana.
No water in the taps in our part of Embakasi for four days.
The estate has had no tap water since Monday. Residents are buying water from vendors.
Rubbish is being dumped on the empty plot next to Ruaka market and it is burned at night.
People keep dumping and burning garbage on the open plot beside the market.
The zebra crossing outside the supermarket on Ngong Road has faded and drivers do not see it.
Pedestrian crossing paint near the supermarket has worn off.
A large tree branch has fallen and blocks half of the footpath near the church in Westlands.
Tawi kubwa la mti limeanguka na kuziba nusu ya njia ya watembea kwa miguu karibu na kanisa Westlands.
One street light near the Donholm bus stop flickers on and off all night.
Flickering street lamp at the bus stop.
A manhole cover is missing on the main road in Pipeline. A motorbike fell into the hole last night.
Kifuniko cha shimo la maji taka hakipo kwenye barabara kuu Pipeline. Pikipiki ilianguka ndani jana usiku.
The road to the estate behind Zimmerman market has deep gullies after the rains and cars cannot pass.
Barabara ya kwenda estate nyuma ya Zimmerman market imeharibika sana baada ya mvua, magari haziwezi pita.
The communal water tap at the market leaks slowly all day and water is being wasted.
The public tap at the market drips all day.
The litter bins in the small park are full.
Bins at the park are overflowing.
Part of the road next to the bridge in South C has collapsed, leaving a deep hole at the edge.
The road beside the bridge has caved in on one side.
Street lights on Jogoo Road near the stage are off.
Taa za barabarani kwenye Jogoo Road karibu na stage hazifanyi kazi.
The culvert near the estate gate is partly blocked with soil.
Culvert iko blocked na udongo karibu na gate ya estate.
Part of the railing on the footbridge over the river in Mathare is missing.
The handrail on the Mathare footbridge is broken.
A water meter pit beside the footpath has been left open and someone could fall in.
Open water meter chamber next to the footpath with no cover.
The road sign at the Kawangware junction has been knocked down.
The security light at the market toilet block is not working.
Broken drain cover outside the shops on the next street.
Maji yanatoka kwa nguvu kidogo sana kwenye nyumba za ghorofa.
There are no litter bins at the matatu stage.
Several small potholes along the service lane behind the flats.
Street light pole leaning dangerously after a car hit it.
Mtaro wa kando ya barabara umejaa plastic bags na haupitishi maji.
Deep pothole on the Kangemi bypass at the bend. Two cars have burst tyres this week.
Edges of the tarmac are breaking off along the road to the shopping centre.
Barabara ya Riruta ina mashimo mengi tangu mvua ianze.
Road markings at the roundabout are faded.
Bridge ya Dagoretti imeanza kuvunjika upande mmoja, magari makubwa bado yanapita.
Gravel road to the estate is badly eroded and very dusty.
Loose kerb stones along the walkway outside the shops.
Barabara ya Mwiki imejaa matope na watu hawawezi kutembea.
Street lights on the main road in Utawala go off every evening around 9 pm.
One lamp on the shopping centre car park is not working.
Nguzo ya taa imeanguka na waya za umeme ziko chini kando ya njia.
The whole street behind the market has had no lighting for two weeks.
Taa za street karibu na Kariokor market zimezimika tangu last week.
Street light stays on during the day.
Dark stretch of road between the stage and the estate, lights broken.
The main storm drain on the estate road is completely blocked and houses flood when it rains.
Mtaro umeziba kwa takataka na maji yanatuama barabarani.
Grass and weeds growing in the roadside drain.
Maji ya mvua yanaingia kwa nyumba because mtaro umeziba completely.
Sewage is leaking from a manhole onto the footpath.
Small puddle forms at the gate after rain because the drain is shallow.
Drainage channel collapsed along the road and the water now runs on the tarmac.
Main water pipe burst along the road, the whole area has no water and the road is flooding.
Hatujapata maji kwa mabomba wiki nzima.
Water from the taps is slightly brown in the mornings.
Maji yanakuja once a week tu, na pressure iko chini sana.
Leaking valve on the water main next to the shops.
The water kiosk tap is broken and drips.
Sewage appears to be mixing with the water supply, the tap water smells bad.
A huge pile of uncollected rubbish is blocking the road and attracting rats near the school.
Takataka hazijaokotwa kwa wiki mbili kwenye eneo letu.
Some litter around the bus stop.
Garbage truck haijakuja for two weeks, takataka zimejaa kila mahali.
Overflowing skip at the market, rubbish spreading onto the road.
The recycling bins at the estate are full.
Takataka zinachomwa karibu na shule na moshi unaingia madarasani.
Rubbish dumped in the river channel near the bridge.
Damaged bus shelter roof, sheets hanging loose.
An electricity cable is hanging low across the footpath near the market.
Public bench in the park is broken.
Mti umeanguka kando ya barabara na umeziba sehemu ya barabara.
Graffiti on the wall of the public toilet.
Signboard ya barabara imeanguka na iko kando ya road.
Stray dogs are gathering at the dumpsite and chasing children on the way to school.
Potholes forming at the entrance to the estate road.
Two street lights along the bypass are dim.
Water collects in the dip of the road after every rain because there is no drain.
Kibao cha kupunguza mwendo karibu na shule kimefifia.
